name: scellecs/morpeh
description: ECS framework for Unity and .NET with a simple, struct-based API requiring no code generation and minimal setup. Offers cache-friendly storage and straightforward system/filter architecture.
score_rationale: Clean, no-codegen Unity ECS with 641 stars, MIT licensed, maintained through January 2025, appealing to developers who find Entitas boilerplate excessive.
summary: Lightweight Unity ECS with no code generation and minimal boilerplate
